title: Phase 3b: Disposition coverage reconciliation
status_detail: After human acceptance and verified closeout of the c3 current-fact supplement at commit b6b0be18eb0ddf95508d99978aae797da45274bc, bounded task-state inspection found no active selection, the Phase 3 parent deferred between children, and automatic successor activation disabled. The accepted Phase 3 disposition plan covers 35 F0 package surfaces and 985 predecessor routes, while the accepted supplement records 47 current surfaces and 471 separately keyed supplemental candidates. The human asked `next?` and was recommended to record and activate only a disposition-coverage-reconciliation task before D1. The suggested response was `Authorize recording and activation of the disposition-coverage-reconciliation task only. Keep D1–D21 and automatic successor activation inactive.` The human responded exactly `recommendation authorized`. This response is normalized as authorization to record, select, and perform only this bounded reconciliation planning task. It does not select a disposition architecture, classify a route, amend the accepted Phase 3 plan, activate D1–D21, authorize production or documentation mutation, or provide acceptance of the task result. Provisional decision support now records exact SHA-256/byte identities for nine authoritative inputs; compares exactly three materially distinct architectures; and recommends, without selecting, Option A's cohort-adjacent overlay DAG. The canonical proposed map assigns all 47 current surfaces, preserves all 985 predecessor routes in their accepted D1-D21 cohorts, and assigns all 471 separately keyed supplemental candidates exactly once across six explicit overlay owners. Its 27-owner prerequisite graph is acyclic and all support, compatibility, public-API, scientific-validation, release, and publication conclusions remain neutral. The decision document and packet are provisional, are not human accepted, and require independent architecture and integration review followed by a separate A/B/C/D human choice. This task remains planning and selected; the Phase 3 parent remains deferred; D1-D21 and automatic successor activation remain inactive. The operator responded exactly `recommendation authorized`, authorizing one bounded same-writer correction for architecture findings AR-01 and AR-02 followed by focused architecture and integration re-review. The provisional correction introduces a frozen closed typed reconciliation domain and typed parser, adapts accepted F0 and supplement facts through their existing typed parsers, adds nested/discriminant/duplicate/ordering/cross-record malformed probes, and binds a non-self-referential immutable request projection reconstructed from stable selected-Task fields. Focused request-drift probes cover the decision question, scope, authority inputs, and no-mutation boundary. The three options, Option A recommendation, 47/985/471 map, neutral claim boundaries, and all NO_ACTION_REQUIRED and SAFE_TO_DEFER findings are preserved. This corrected result remains provisional and not human accepted pending focused independent architecture and integration re-review and a separate human A/B/C/D choice. Status remains planning, selection remains active, the parent remains deferred, D1-D21 remain inactive, and automatic successor activation remains false. The operator responded exactly `recommendation authorized`, authorizing only the recommended one-sentence attribution correction, completion-validator rerun, and focused integration confirmation. The provisional correction now accurately attributes closed-schema, discriminant, ordering, relation, duplicate-key, canonical-encoding, and embedded request/hash consistency checks to the typed packet parser, while attributing reconstruction of the stable projection from the live selected Task and rejection of live request drift to the completion validator. No option, recommendation, request identity, 47/985/471 map, packet, lifecycle state, or other claim changed. This attribution correction remains provisional and not human accepted pending focused integration confirmation and the separate human A/B/C/D choice. The operator first selected the recommendation with exact response `recommendation authorized` and then responded exactly `continue` after being told the reconciliation task awaited durable decision recording and separate closeout authorization. These responses are normalized as human selection and authority to durably record only Option A, `cohort_adjacent_overlay_dag`, within the existing reconciliation-owned paths. Option A selection records the coverage architecture only: it does not accept or close this Task, authorize commit or push, amend the accepted Phase 3 plan, classify support or compatibility, record or activate D1-D21, M1, an overlay, an implementation child, V1, Phase 4, or authorize dev integration or automatic successor activation. This Task remains planning and selected pending separate human acceptance; the Phase 3 parent remains deferred between children; every successor remains inactive. The operator then responded exactly `accepted` to the sole pending request to accept the durably recorded Option A decision and authorize managed closeout. This response is normalized as human acceptance of the reconciliation decision record and authority for its validated managed administrative closeout only. The Task is `closed_human_accepted_pass`, selection is clear, the Phase 3 parent remains `deferred_between_children`, and automatic successor activation remains false. D1-D21, M1, S01-S06, implementation children, V1, and Phase 4 remain inactive. Acceptance does not classify route support or compatibility, amend the accepted Phase 3 plan, authorize dev integration, establish scientific validation, or authorize release or publication.
objective: Produce bounded, reviewed decision support for reconciling the accepted D1-D21 disposition partition with all 47 current package surfaces and 471 separately keyed supplemental candidates while preserving the 985 predecessor-route lineage and making no support or compatibility decision.

completion_criteria: The decision packet binds exact accepted input identities and accounts for all 47 current surfaces, 985 predecessor routes, and 471 supplemental candidates with no duplicate, omission, alias, or silent reassignment.

The advisory decision document uses the required architecture-decision structure, presents exactly three materially distinct defensible architectures with explicit consequences, and identifies one recommendation without recording it as a human decision; the concise checkpoint proposal offers A, B, C, and D — Reconsider or defer.

The recommended map has explicit ownership for every surface and candidate, an acyclic prerequisite graph, and no support, compatibility, public-API, scientific-validation, release, or publication conclusion.

The no-argument completion validator passes canonical decoding, input identity, cardinality, uniqueness, coverage, lineage, graph, lifecycle, ownership, Harness projection, static typing, formatting, and whitespace checks.
Independent architecture and integration reviews report no blocking finding, after which the task stops for separate human selection without amending the Phase 3 plan or activating D1-D21.
exclusions: Do not classify any route as supported or unsupported or assign a compatibility disposition.

Do not modify F0, the accepted current-fact supplement, the accepted Phase 3 plan, package initializers, production source, tests, resources, public documentation, dependencies, lockfiles, calculations, or publication content.
